BCBCFF吸血鬼是所有不死怪物中最恐怖的一种。人们认为它们是邪恶男巫的实验品，目的就是想通过吸取活人的血液来延长他的生命。

- Relentlessly hunt any heroes they encounter


BCBCFFWerewolves are a hybrid creature resulting from either a Human or Varg infected with a lycanthropic disease.  Their continuous pain and rage drive them into a homicidal mania.

——无情攻击它们遇到的任何英雄


BCBCFF狼人是人类或瓦格怪感染了狼变病毒后形成的畸形。长期的疼痛和暴躁驱使它们成为杀人狂。

- Weak melee combatant


BCBCFFZombies are animated corpses still in an early state of decay. When the ether winds of Ardania blow with great strength, recently fallen heroes may arise from graveyards within your kingdom.

——战斗力弱


BCBCFF僵尸是处于早期腐烂状态的活尸。当阿丹尼亚吹过带有巨大的能量的风时，最近死去的英雄就会从你王国的墓地里复活。

- Casts powerful spells of mass destruction


BCBCFFPowerful sorcerers often place these dread specters as guardians. Of the heroes who have faced a Black Phantom, few have survived.

——施用强大的毁灭性魔法



BCBCFF法力无边的男巫常常用这些可怕的幽灵来作卫兵。凡是遇到黑色幽灵的英雄，没有几个人能活下来。

- May attack at a range with fiery blasts


BCBCFFThis three-headed guardian of the nether regions often enters Ardania, enslaving those he encounters in horrific dungeon like pits.  Legends tell that he draws strength from the suffering he inflicts.

——可以用火风暴攻击一定范围内的敌人


BCBCFF这个阴间的三头守卫经常进入阿丹尼亚，奴役那些它在令人毛骨悚然的地牢遇到的人们。

BCBCFFThis wandering behemoth seeks revenge on the hero who so cruelly blinded him many years ago in his island cave.

——极其强大的格斗技能


BCBCFF这个四处游荡的巨兽要找那个多年前在它的洞穴残忍地刺瞎它的英雄复仇。

- Extremely skilled in melee combat

- Relentlessly hunts the heroes he encounters


BCBCFFRrongol is a fearful predator, stalking Ardania's wilderness with ravenous zeal.  Woe to the heroes who cross his track in the wildlands.

——特别擅长格斗

BCBCFF朗格尔是个可怕的肉食动物，它怀着贪婪的野心潜入阿丹尼亚的荒地。让我们为那些在荒地遭受它毒手的英雄致哀吧。

- Possesses many powerful spells


BCBCFFOnce a high priestess of Krypta, the Liche Queen is now the sworn enemy of all things living.  Her undead minions are a considerable threat to any that settle too close to her lair.

——拥有许多强大的魔法


BCBCFF理查王后曾经是墓穴的高级女巫，现在是所有人的不共戴天之敌。她的手下不死怪物对任何离她巢穴太近的居民都是一个相当大的威胁。

- Can summon dark creatures to do his bidding

- Has knowledge of many spells both offensive and defensive


BCBCFFA master of dark magic, the Witch King is a terrible foe for any sovereign. Having extended his life through dark sorcery, he is now centuries old.  It was he who threatened the destruction of Ravenswood in northern Ardania K.A. 1205.

——可以召唤黑暗生物来听从他的命令

——既懂攻击魔法又懂防御魔法。


BCBCFF女巫国王是黑暗魔法的主人，对所有国家来说都是一个可怕的敌人。由于用黑暗魔法延长了生命，到现在他已经活了几个世纪了。就是他在K.A.1205年摧毁了阿丹尼亚北部的黑暗森林。

- Breathes a destructive gout of flame at opponents

- Invulnerable to many weapons and attacks


BCBCFFVendral, the two-headed dragon of Grimspire, is thought to be little more than an ancient myth.  The frontier around the Hellfire Mountains, known to the locals as the Mountains of Doom, has been settled for nearly a century.  Expeditions into the heart of the mountainous range began this spring.  The heroes undertaking this quest have yet to return with word of their adventures.

——向对手喷出毁灭性的一团火焰

——许多武器和攻击方式都伤不了它


BCBCFF格里姆斯派亚的双头龙瓦尼德尔，被人们认为是一个古代的神话。地狱火山脉是当地有名的死亡山脉，人们在这座山脉的周围边境已经定居近一个世纪了。今年春天，深入该山脉中心的探险开始了。接受任务的英雄们一定会带回他们探险的消息。

- Destroying this Slave Pit will free the heroes crucified around it


BCBCFFThese pits of despair are the infernal torture chambers of Url Shekk.  Free for a time from his post as guardian of the Nether Regions, he seeks to recreate his realm of languishing and suffering here in Ardania.

"Woe unto them caught in the halls of Three Headed!" - Prophecy of Juleck

——摧毁这个奴隶地坑可以使钉在十字架上的英雄重获自由


BCBCFF这些令人绝望的地坑是阿尔塞克用来折磨人的地狱般的刑房。自从不再做阴间的守卫，他就一直寻求在阿丹尼亚重建他那充满苦难和痛苦的王国。

"痛苦降临到那些被抓到三头怪那里的人们的身上！" ——朱莱克的预言

- Destroying the nearby Slave Pit will free the heroes crucified around it


BCBCFFHeroes who have quested against Url Shekk in the past are often crucified as a warning to others.  The heroes of Ardania are strong of heart and may survive this torture if freed in time.

——摧毁附近的奴隶地坑可以使钉在十字架上的英雄重获自由


BCBCFF过去那些反抗过阿尔塞克的英雄通常被钉在十字架上，以警示其他人。阿丹尼亚的英雄们意志坚强，如果即时解救，他们就可以逃过这场劫难。

- Destroy this site to recover the Holy Chalice


BCBCFFThis most holy of sites is rumored to house the fabled Chalice of Lunord.  This fabled chalice is said to have passed in and out of history, appearing always as an omen of rebirth and new life. Eventually it was bestowed upon Makkat the Mad, along with the proclamation of the new gods, on which the temples of Agrela, Dauros, Fervus, and Krypta were founded.

——摧毁这个地方来得到圣餐杯


BCBCFF谣传这个最神圣的地方存放着传说中的卢诺德圣餐杯。据说这个圣餐杯已经经历了风风雨雨，一直被看做是再生和新生命的预兆。最终，在宣布新的神诞生，建造阿格雷拉、道尔罗斯、费尔弗斯和墓穴神庙时，它被授予了疯子玛凯特。

- Destroy this vault to recover the magic sword within


BCBCFFThis vault contains a legendary Blade of Sydrian.  Each of Sydrian's heroes carried an enchanted sword marking them champions of the realm.  Legend tells that these weapons could dispel wards of invulnerability.

——摧毁这个地窖来得到里面的魔法剑


BCBCFF这个地窖中存有一把传说中的赛德利亚之剑。每个赛德利亚英雄都佩带了一把魔法剑，标志着他们是王国的战士。传说这些武器能破解那些刀枪不入的防护。

- Destroy this vault to recover the Crown of Sydrian


BCBCFFFashioned of gold and nevryl, this crown of your forefathers was lost two generations ago to the Minotaur warlord Gorsha Blackhoof.  Few of the noble lines of Ardania possess heirlooms of this magnitude. Recovering this relic will boost the morale of your subjects and your standing amongst the other nobles.

——摧毁这个地窖来得到赛德利亚王冠。


BCBCFF这个装饰着金饰品的王冠是你祖先的王冠，它在前两代国王之前就丢失并到了牛头怪战神格尔沙·布莱克胡夫的手里。阿丹尼亚很少有贵族拥有这么贵重的传家宝。重新得到这个圣物可以鼓舞英雄的士气，巩固你在其他贵族中的地位。

BCBCFFThis ancient vault appears to have been built in the traditional Volencian style.  The Line of Valmorgen has constructed many such sites to safe guard various artifacts.  However, this particular building seems oddly run down and ill kept for such a building.
BCBCFF这个古老的地窖是按照传统的沃伦西亚风格修建的。瓦尔摩根建立了许多这种地窖来保护各种宝物。然而，这个特殊的建筑看上去似乎要坍塌了，去保护这样一个建筑似乎有点不可思议。

- Destroy this fortress to drive the Liche Queen from her lair


BCBCFFThis citadel of evil is the center of the Liche Queen's power.  Centuries old, it pulses with the red ambient glow of foul magic. Strong necromantic forces summon forth the dead to guard this dreaded stronghold.

——摧毁这个堡垒，把理查女王从她的洞穴里赶走。


BCBCFF这个邪恶的根据地是理查女王的势力中心。几个世纪来，它依靠发出红色光芒的邪恶魔法存留下来。强大的死灵巫术召唤亡灵来守护这个可怕的城堡。

- Destroy this tower to end the Witch King's stranglehold


BCBCFFNearly three centuries after his defeat by the Rangers and Barbarians of the Ravenswood treaty, the Witch King has returned to befoul this area.  From this tower his minions have spread the plague that has so afflicted your kingdom.

——摧毁这个城堡结束女巫国王的统治


BCBCFF在女巫国王被游侠和野蛮人的联盟击败的三个世纪后，女巫国王又回到了这个地区作乱。它的下属从这座城堡里出来传播瘟疫，使你的王国倍受煎熬。

- Destroy this tomb to recover the Blade of Krolm


BCBCFFOver two millennia ago Andraxal-Kerlazor, mightiest of the Dragon Kings was slain by Krolm.  The last of the Noble Dragons, his death heralded the end of the Dragon Realms and the birth of the Barbarian Kings of old.  The prophet Juleck has foretold that the legendary Blade of Krolm will be found in this ancient tomb.

——摧毁这个坟墓以获得克罗尔玛之剑


BCBCFF两千多年前，最强大的龙王安德拉克塞尔·克尔拉泽被克罗尔玛杀死了。作为最后的高贵龙族，他的死亡宣告了巨龙王国的毁灭和野蛮人王国的诞生。预言家朱莱克曾经预言，在这个古墓中可以找到传说中的克罗尔玛之剑。

- Destroy this site to recover one of the fragments


BCBCFFThese few vaults are all that remain of Brashnard's legacy.  The first great Wizard of Ardania, Brashnard sought to elevate society through learning, science, and wizardry. Students of Brashnard's teaching are said to have gathered the sphere's sections and set up these vaults to safeguard the shards.

——摧毁这个地点以获得其中一个碎片s


BCBCFF这几个地窖是阿丹尼亚的第一个伟大的法师布莱史纳德的所有遗产。 布莱史纳德渴望通过学习科学和巫术来促使社会进步。野人的头领，血斧罗格纳非常害怕布莱史纳德以及他所支持的一切。传说在一次冲突中，罗格纳打碎了布莱史纳德的水晶球，两人均死于一场随之而来的魔法灾难。据说布莱史纳德的学生将水晶球的碎片收集起来，并建起这些地窖来保护这些碎片。

- Destroy this tower to free the captive within


BCBCFFThis dungeon tower appears to have been recently refurbished.  The craftsmanship of the gate and fortifications is not known to any of your architects.  Brute force will have to be employed to open this prison.

——摧毁这座城堡解放里面的俘虏


BCBCFF这个地下城堡似乎最近整修过。你的建筑师不知道这个建筑的大门和防御工事的建筑技巧，所以必须使用武力来打开这个监狱。

- Destroy this lair to prevent your enemies from reinforcing with additional forces


BCBCFFArdanian nobles will face many enemies in their time as Sovereign.  Often these foes dwell in the immediate vicinity of an Ardanian settlement.  Clearing the land of such lairs is vital to the success of any aspiring sovereign.

——摧毁这个巢穴阻止敌人得到额外的增援


BCBCFF阿丹尼亚的贵族在他们统治的时期会面临很多敌人。通常这些敌人都住在阿丹尼亚居住地附近。摧毁这些巢穴对任何一位有抱负的君王的成都是至关重要的。

- Statues raise the loyalty of the heroes in your kingdom


BCBCFFAssured that their deeds will not go unrecognized, your heroes strive to complete their quests with renewed determination.

——雕像可以提高你王国英雄的忠诚度。


BCBCFF由于确保了他们的功绩不被磨灭，你的英雄们会以新的决心去努力完成他们的使命。
